collection.title: VW Golf SV 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Golf SV 2014 Onwards model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Golf which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.

image.alt: VW Golf SV 2014 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
